_comment: Copy to config.json and edit. Run `capture` then `pull`, then `query`.

dates._weekdaysHelp: null = every day. [5,0] = Fridays and Sundays only (0=Sun..6=Sat).
dates._rangeHelp: One request per month per destination, so this span is 10 requests each. Seats release ~330 days out; the scanner refuses to look past that.

_tripLengthHelp: null = one-way search. 7 = also request a return 7 days later.
_settleSelectorHelp: Optional CSS selector that appears when results render; speeds up each search.
_urlTemplateHelp: Only used by the `scan` fallback. The `pull` path uses out/recipes.json from `capture`.
_headlessHelp: Applies to `scan` only. `pull` opens a visible window unless you pass --headless, because SAS refuses headless browsers.
_destinationsHelp: One request per destination per month. Trim this list, or narrow dates, if a run takes longer than you want. Re-pulling is idempotent, so a long run can be done in chunks with --limit.
